g.text: Resolution — a typestate, not a runtime flag
Resolving twice is a type error, not a
generic over a stage would hold an item
takes ONE parameter however many deferred
fields it has, and transitions wholesale.
A container cannot hold a mix — "half
parsed" is not a state anything downstream
the SAME tokens. A generator never has to
ask which state it is holding — splicing
is uniform, and resolution never costs you
Why a typestate here but not for Extraction
Resolved/unresolved is a true binary with no
second axis. Extraction has one — a node can
have a value AND a complaint — so it is a
struct. The two decisions are consistent,
